fixture_scope: only exact pure _racimo and racimos_de; no imports/loaders/outcomes/notebook execution

findings.fact: pseudo pool requires approved bar and clock; no same-session or detector-negative filter
findings.meaning: historical activity-control result cannot be relabeled as verified zone-free incremental comparison

findings.fact: _racimo assigns older zones racimo_bar at the later formation bar
findings.meaning: post-run membership cannot be backdated as known at original zone creation

findings.fact: cluster start/low/high can expand; start0/low0/high0/bar retain formation snapshot
findings.meaning: use declared as-of formation snapshot; later extents are not available at initial anchor

findings.fact: racimos_de discards session identity and _racimo uses bar distance without session filter
findings.meaning: cross-session cluster is possible in a synthetic example; actual prevalence and impact not measured

findings.fact: occ/activity/trend/pre-range use global bar windows; removing session gap duration is not ensuring same-session prewindow
findings.meaning: future protocol must declare same-session vs carried history and audit window completeness
